name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three static virtual hosts, enables HTTPS, deploys static landing pages, and applies host security controls including Fail2ban, firewall, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and logging, creates required directories, and applies platform-specific Redis configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI application from GitHub, creates its virtual environment and database credentials, and runs it through systemd with Uvicorn.
